clue.text: Figure encountered earlier on radio (local)?

indicators.note: what is broadcast on radio is heard rather than seen, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: encountered is MET and earlier is AFORE, a dialect word, which is what '(local)' flags

explanation.surface: A puzzling question about some local radio figure the listener once met.
explanation.walkthrough: '(local)' marks AFORE as a regional word for 'earlier'; MET AFORE said aloud gives the figure of speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor is a figure of speech, an image carried over from one thing to another.

clue.text: Teach English and a bit of history around University College

indicators.note: around says one piece wraps the other here, the date enclosing the college

parts.note: a date is a single point or fragment of history
UC abbreviates University College

explanation.surface: A school task: teaching English plus some history at a London college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' signals that the college sits within the history piece; the 'and' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To educate is to instruct or school someone, the same as teaching them.

clue.text: Malaria, ultimately, one helps to spread

definitions.text: Malaria, ultimately, one helps to spread

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Malaria
spreading the letters about means the words one helps are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something that ultimately aids the spread of malaria.
explanation.walkthrough: The last letter of Malaria, A, comes before NOPHELES, the anagram of ONE HELPS signalled by 'to spread'. The whole clue also describes the mosquito genus.
explanation.definitionFit: Anopheles is the mosquito genus whose females carry the malaria parasite between people.

clue.text: Group of women in the East about to cause damage

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the other, the compass point going within the damage

parts.note: to harm is to cause damage
E is the compass abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: Women somewhere in the East are poised to wreak havoc.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts E inside HARM; 'about' is a link here. 'in the East' looks attached to the women, but it is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A harem is the women of a household in a traditionally Muslim home, a group kept apart.

clue.text: Will highlight family members who inherit and those who don't?

definitions.text: Will highlight family members who inherit and those who don't?

parts.words: Will highlight family members who inherit and those who don't
parts.note: read as the provisions of a legal will naming which kin get the estate, and also as the grammatical term for subordinate sentence parts beginning 'who'

explanation.surface: A testament spelling out which kin get money and which are cut off.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's own wording 'who inherit and those who don't' contains grammatical clauses about relatives, while a will has clauses about relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammatical subordinate units opening with 'who' or 'which' describe a noun, and a will's provisions concerning kin are equally such clauses.

clue.text: Everything ruminant eats is green

indicators.note: eats means the animal takes the other piece inside itself

parts.note: a cow is the best-known cud-chewing animal
everything means all

explanation.surface: A cow chews all the grass, which is green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' looks like a colour but means inexperienced.
explanation.definitionFit: Callow describes youthful inexperience, just as a green recruit is naive.

clue.text: Comparatively bright pupil heading for Eton, looked after by responsible adult

indicators.note: being looked after by someone puts you within their care, so these pieces go inside

parts.note: a carer is an adult responsible for someone
L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

indicators.note: heading picks the opening letter of the word Eton

explanation.surface: A clever schoolboy bound for Eton, in the care of a guardian.
explanation.walkthrough: L and E (Eton's first letter) go inside CARER. Eton is England's famous private boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearer, the comparative of clear, means brighter, as a sky or a mind can be.

clue.text: Sponge spondulicks when in city

indicators.note: when in says the money goes inside the city's abbreviation

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
oof, like spondulicks, is old slang for money

explanation.surface: Someone sponging money while staying in town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when in' marks the container. 'Sponge' looks like a verb meaning to scrounge, but it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A loofah is the dried fibrous gourd used as a bath sponge.

clue.text: Number turning up leading to outbreak of a riot in the province

indicators.note: leading to puts the first piece ahead of the next
in a down clue turning up reads the abbreviation backwards from bottom to top
an outbreak scatters things, so the letters of a riot are rearranged

explanation.surface: Numbers turning out lead to a riot breaking out in a province.
explanation.walkthrough: NO turned up gives ON, followed by TARIO, the anagram of A RIOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Ontario is a Canadian province, the most populous of them.

clue.text: Total failure to score in outlandish sport?

parts.note: a total is a sum
a failure to score is nil, shown as O

explanation.surface: Scoring zero in some odd foreign game.
explanation.definitionFit: Sumo is Japanese wrestling, a sport exotic to Western eyes.

clue.text: Breakfast ingredient-do eat when cooked, between pieces of bread

indicators.note: between puts the anagram inside, like a sandwich filling

parts.note: rolls are small individual loaves of bread

indicators.note: cooking changes the form, so the words do eat are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for a breakfast sandwich: cook it and eat it in bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when cooked' turns DO EAT into EDOAT, and 'between' puts that inside the bread, like a filling.
explanation.definitionFit: Rolled oats are flattened oat grains used for porridge and muesli at breakfast.

clue.text: Device for catching out MOT cheater?

indicators.note: out signals the letters of MOT cheater are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A gadget to catch someone cheating on their car's roadworthiness test.
explanation.walkthrough: The MOT is the UK's annual roadworthiness test for cars, so a vehicle gadget feels apt.
explanation.definitionFit: A tachometer is an instrument showing an engine's revolutions per minute.

clue.text: Area covered by Mercator, East to West

indicators.note: on a map east to west runs right to left, so the letters are read backwards
covered by says the letters lie inside the word Mercator

explanation.surface: An area shown on a Mercator map projection.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside Mercator lies ERCA, which read 'East to West' gives the unit.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit of land area of 4,840 square yards.

clue.text: Measure commander holds — piece of string?

indicators.note: holds means the officer's letters enclose the measure

parts.note: CO is commanding officer
an ell is an old measure of cloth length

explanation.surface: A commander holding a measure of string.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piece of string' means an instrument in the string section.
explanation.definitionFit: The cello is a bowed instrument of the orchestra's string section.

clue.text: Public disagreement about Hohenzollern leader's downfall

indicators.note: about says the joined words surround the initial

parts.note: overt means open, public
a row is a quarrel

indicators.note: leader's points to the first letter of the word Hohenzollern

explanation.surface: An open quarrel brings down the head of the Hohenzollern dynasty.
explanation.walkthrough: OVERT and ROW go 'about' H. The Hohenzollerns were the German imperial dynasty that fell in 1918.
explanation.definitionFit: An overthrow is a toppling from power, a ruler's fall.

clue.text: Superior ski instructor's pupils?

definitions.meaning: a group of learners taught on the upper slopes would be a lofty class

explanation.definitionFit: High-class means top-quality, and a skiing lesson held up a mountain is literally a class held at altitude.

clue.text: Drug from the chemist specially prescribed? Bit of embroidery there

indicators.note: specially prescribed suggests letters made up into a new mixture

parts.note: E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: A drug made up specially by the pharmacist, with some sewing nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: Take E from THE CHEMIST, and rearrange what is left, as 'specially prescribed' says.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemstitch is a decorative needlework stitch used to finish a hem.

clue.text: Use feet, we're told

definitions.meaning: heard, feet sounds like feat, a daring deed

explanation.definitionFit: To exploit is to make use of, and an exploit is a bold feat or achievement.

clue.text: Smoke causes anger

definitions.meaning: the perfumed smoke of burning spices

explanation.definitionFit: Incense is fragrant burning resin, and to incense someone is to infuriate them.

clue.text: A looker, or one who thinks she is?

definitions.meaning: a man who stares at a woman thinks she is a looker, an attractive person

explanation.definitionFit: An ogler stares at others, so is literally someone looking, and judges the woman watched to be good-looking.

clue.text: On the way to Bordeaux

parts.note: read as the French phrase for travelling along, apt for Bordeaux, a French city

explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase is used in English for travelling along towards a destination.

clue.text: Stone outcrop a little less visible

indicators.note: less visible says the answer lies partly concealed inside the words outcrop a little

explanation.surface: A rocky outcrop slightly obscured.
explanation.definitionFit: Opal is a gemstone with a shifting play of colours.

clue.text: Be disposed to absorb reading, possibly?

definitions.text: Be disposed to absorb reading, possibly?

indicators.note: absorbing takes something in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: to lean towards something is to be inclined to it
R is one of the three Rs, reading, writing and arithmetic

explanation.surface: Being inclined to soak up some reading.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes inside LEAN. The whole clue also describes study.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn is to take in knowledge, which reading may supply.

clue.text: Speedy advance a character obtains with it?

parts.note: a charge is a rush forward
a card is an eccentric person, a character

explanation.surface: A character makes a speedy advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'obtains with it' is a cryptic description: it is what one buys goods with.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge card is a payment card, with purchases settled later.

clue.text: Zest shown by American tycoon initially joining in game

indicators.note: joining in puts these pieces inside the game

parts.note: Go is the Japanese board game
US means American

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word tycoon

explanation.surface: An American magnate shows enthusiasm joining a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joining in' marks the container; 'shown by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is hearty enjoyment, as zest is.

clue.text: Leading features of former empire?

parts.note: the facial parts that lead, sticking out in front, described as belonging to the ancient empire based in Italy

explanation.definitionFit: Aquiline noses with a prominent bridge are named after the Latin people, who led the face forward with them.

clue.text: Fit? Not with this

parts.note: the illness is a fit of shivering, and nobody is fit, healthy, while suffering it

explanation.definitionFit: Ague is malarial fever with fits of shivering, which leaves a sufferer far from healthy.

clue.text: Attitude evinced by woman Tory ignored

indicators.note: ignored means the party abbreviation is dropped from the name

parts.note: Constance is a woman's name
CON abbreviates Conservative, the Tory party

explanation.surface: A Conservative woman's views are disregarded.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is a position or point of view on an issue.

clue.text: Burns they sometimes consider to require special dressing

definitions.text: Burns they sometimes consider to require special dressing

parts.words: Burns they sometimes consider to require special dressing
parts.note: read as injuries needing bandages, but Burns is the poet, whose annual suppers people from north of the border attend in kilts and full dress

explanation.definitionFit: Natives of Scotland honour the poet Robert Burns at Burns Night suppers, often in Highland dress.
